note: Judicial races on the 10001 ballot. NOT included in the coverage denominator. Under NY's judicial conduct rule 22 NYCRR 100.5(A)(4)(d), judicial candidates may not make pledges, promises, or commitments on issues likely to come before the court, so the 9 policy issues don't apply. No stances were mapped and none were invented. Suggest showing the bio, qualifications, or bar-association ratings instead of issue stances.
